lines.en: I haven't taken a single step.
My feet are welded to the floor.
You want to see me walk? Too bad.
This body doesn't move.
The light blinks, and I'm still here.
There's no motor in these joints.

lines.zh: 地上有一圈灰，是我的轮廓。
lines.en: A ring of dust marks where I stand.

lines.zh: 我眼睛里的灯，闪了一下。
lines.en: The light in my eyes flickered.
I can't even turn my head.
I've been taking this step for a hundred years.
Don't wait for me to walk over.

lines.zh: 走廊里，只有你的脚步声。
lines.en: In the corridor, only your footsteps sound.
I don't move, and I don't make a sound.
That's the whole of my ability.
The diner lights died; I'm still here.
I've stood here a long time.
The tube light hums.

lines.zh: 我这身绒布，一碰就掉毛。
lines.en: This plush of mine sheds at a touch.
This diner closed long ago.
I'm waiting for the show to start.
My name is on the sign.
The floorboards creak.
I'm not tired, and I don't sleep.
Even a prop counts as present.
My paint is peeling.
The night here is long.
You're staring at me.
Stare as long as you like. It's the same.
I won't move. Rest easy.
But might you start imagining things?
This face has been smiling a long time.
The light dimmed on my side.
Your shadow falls on me.
Are my eyes really that bright?
Step back and I can't see you.
You're not here to order, are you.

lines.zh: 门把响了一声，我的头没转。
lines.en: The doorknob clicks; my head doesn't turn.

lines.zh: 我的镜头对着你，不过没开。
lines.en: My lens points at you, but it's off.
Did you hear something?
That sound wasn't me.
I don't even breathe.
You're standing close to me.

lines.zh: 再近一点，也什么都不会发生。
lines.en: Closer still, and nothing will happen.
You should check behind you.

lines.zh: 这层漆掉了，露出里面的铁。
lines.en: The paint flaked, and the iron shows.
You're hitting an empty shell.
My frame bent, but I'm still standing.
It's hollow inside.
That tore the cloth.
I'm still smiling.

lines.zh: 我的肩关节掉下来半寸。
lines.en: My shoulder joint has slipped half an inch.
You bent the iron frame.
I don't feel pain. It just looks bad.
Repairs are expensive.

lines.zh: 食物放在我面前也没用。
lines.en: Food before me is useless.
This mouth is painted on.
Your pizza will go cold.

lines.zh: 餐盘空了，我的线还接着。
lines.en: The plate is empty; my wires still hum.
You hold it up, and I can't smell it.
Leave those for the guests.
There's nothing inside me.
Set it on the table. I still won't take it.
That's a bit wasteful.
Eat it yourself.

lines.zh: 你碰得我身上的灰落了一层。
lines.en: Your bump shakes a layer of dust off me.
I settled back to my original angle.
My base is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的脚焊在这块地板上。
lines.en: My feet are welded to this floor.
Your bump sent dust flying.
My arm brushed your shoulder.
I can't step aside.
You ducked under my arm.
The knock echoed through the empty diner.

lines.zh: 我还在原位，纸板做的脚没动。
lines.en: I am still in place; my cardboard feet have not moved.
Such words mean nothing to me.
I'm a doll, not a living thing.

lines.zh: 你要跟一块铁谈感情吗？
lines.en: Do you want romance with a piece of metal?
I won't answer.
My smile is fixed.
You should find someone living.
There's no one else in the diner.
No matter how long the night, nothing changes.
You're talking to yourself.
I'm only a piece of scenery.
I can't pick up anything.
My hands are fixed in place.
I can see what you dropped.
But I won't pick it up.
It rolled to my feet.
Let it stay there.
It sits inside my shadow.
You'd better take it yourself.
I can't even bend over.
Don't count on me.
I don't lock onto anyone.
That isn't in my programming.

lines.zh: 你的手电照进我的空眼眶。
lines.en: Your flashlight shines into my empty eye socket.
Then keep looking.
The sound you heard wasn't me.
My head won't turn that way.
You're walking farther away.
My base is bolted to the floor.
In this diner, only you are alive.
Don't frighten yourself.
By the door, the wind is moving.
Go and look.
I can't issue any command.
No target, and no intent to kill.
You're overthinking it.
I've been smiling all night.
I can't even take a step.

lines.zh: 我的脚从来没离开过这块地。
lines.en: My feet have never left this spot.
You run about, and I stay quiet.
Am I following you with my eyes?
No. You're the one moving.

lines.zh: 你回头看我的次数变多了。
lines.en: You look back at me more often now.
The light flickered again.
I didn't touch it.
Your torch beam sweeps over me.

lines.zh: 我的齿轮卡住了，动不了。
lines.en: My gears are stuck; I can't move.
Only your breathing sounds here.

lines.zh: 你听到的脚步声是回声。
lines.en: The footsteps you hear are echoes.
My shadow is long.
It won't chase you either.
You're getting farther from the door.
Turn around and look.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后那面墙边。
lines.en: I've been by that wall behind you.
Still haven't moved.
I have no attack animation.
Hit me, and I only rock.
My arms won't lift.
You want to see me fight back?
It isn't going to happen.
Your blow chipped my paint.
I tilted, but didn't fall.
Under this cloth is nothing but an iron frame.
You hit iron. Does your hand hurt?

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂着，抬不起来。
lines.en: My arm hangs there; I can't lift it.
You hit canvas, and it thuds.
You knocked my head askew.
My feet haven't shifted at all.
You knocked the dust loose.
I'm tilted, and still not looking at you.
I only sway back into place.
This diner has always been open.
I've always been on this stage.

lines.zh: 灯亮起来的时候，你就看见我了。
lines.en: When the lights came on, you saw me.
I didn't arrive, and I won't leave.
You pushed the door open and saw me.
The dust moved first, then you noticed me.
The stage curtain is half open.
This angle shows me best.
You're standing right in front of me.

lines.zh: 第一次来的人，都会停一下。
lines.en: First-timers always pause.
I've been here far longer than you.
There's no wind outside.
Listen. A music box is playing.
I didn't turn it on either.
My position has never changed.
The name on the plaque is mine.
You shouldn't have come so late.
Now you're inside the diner.

lines.zh: 布一烧，我整张脸都焦了。
lines.en: The cloth caught fire, and my whole face charred.

lines.zh: 我倒了，就再也站不起来。
lines.en: If I fall, I'll never get up again.
Water inside the shell means rust.

lines.zh: 炸得我弹簧和布片一起飞出去。
lines.en: The blast throws my springs and cloth everywhere.

lines.zh: 一根钉子钉进了我的胸口。
lines.en: A nail went into my chest.

lines.zh: 光打过来，我的漆变了色。
lines.en: The light hit me and my paint changed color.

lines.zh: 我站着，一动不动地站着。
lines.en: I stand. Perfectly still.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的骨架都在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and my frame rang.

lines.zh: 掉下去的话，就什么都没了。
lines.en: If I fall in, there'd be nothing left.
